decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system remains a specialist line close to our robust application-specific strengths, and long defense procurement and qualification cycles still justify keeping this option open.

The spring-balanced desk lamp is more peripheral and likely faces faster market feedback than our core project lines, but it still complements office and education applications enough to justify one more year of observation.
The general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in our core market, and continued presence without clear negative signals argues for retaining it as a low-risk option.
As a flagship pendant luminaire aligned with our strategic direction toward advanced interior lighting, we would continue to support it unless performance turned clearly disappointing.

The marine HMI searchlight is a narrow and less future-aligned niche, and after another year the option value looks weaker than the benefit of reallocating resources to LED-oriented and core specialist projects.
The marine searchlight line still fits our specialist transport and harsh-environment capabilities, so despite its niche market we would keep it while commercial potential continues to unfold.
